findings.title: GOV-017's merge gate step 3 still names only the gating reviewer's and shadow judge's verdicts and says 'Only the gating verdict decides', while this phase records the security review as a second verdict with gating: true.
findings.evidence: GOV-017-multi-session-coordination-protocol.md:242-244 (security review recorded with reviewer.type security-review, gating: true) vs :298-300 (merge gate step 3, unmodified by this diff).
findings.consequence: For the first phase that trips the trigger, the merge-gate procedure read literally drops the security verdict from the owner's approval package, defeating REQ-030 R08.
findings.minimal_fix: Edit GOV-017:298-300 to list the security-review verdict when triggered and replace 'Only the gating verdict decides' with wording for two independently gating verdicts.

findings.title: The security-review trigger's first condition is worded at plan granularity ('the phase's plan names a threat surface'), diverging from REQ-030 R08's phase-level wording.
findings.evidence: GOV-017-multi-session-coordination-protocol.md:229-231 vs REQ-030-reviewer-contract.md:68 and GOV-010 P12 ('a plan names each threat surface its phases touch').
findings.consequence: Ambiguous between 'this phase is mapped to a surface' and 'any phase of a plan that names a surface anywhere'; the diff-path condition is the objective backstop.
findings.minimal_fix: Reword to 'the phase's plan maps this phase to a threat surface under GOV-010 P12'.
